name: Codecov
description: GitHub Action that uploads coverage reports for your repository to codecov.io

token.description: Repository upload token - get it from codecov.io. Required only for private repositories

file.description: Path to coverage file to upload

files.description: Comma-separated list of files to upload

directory.description: Directory to search for coverage reports.

flags.description: Flag upload to group coverage metrics (e.g. unittests | integration | ui,chrome)

full_report.description: Specify the path of a full Codecov report to re-upload

commit_parent.description: The commit SHA of the parent for which you are uploading coverage. If not present, the parent will be determined using the API of your repository provider.  Whe

env_vars.description: Environment variables to tag the upload with (e.g. PYTHON | OS,PYTHON)

fail_ci_if_error.description: Specify whether or not CI build should fail if Codecov runs into an error during upload

functionalities.description: Comma-separated list, see the README for options and their usage. Options include `network`, `fixes`, `search`.

gcov_args.description: Extra arguments to pass to gcov

gcov_executable.description: gcov executable to run. Defaults to gcov

gcov_ignore.description: Paths to ignore during gcov gathering

gcov_include.description: Paths to include during gcov gathering

move_coverage_to_trash.description: Move discovered coverage reports to the trash

name.description: User defined upload name. Visible in Codecov UI

network_filter.description: Specify a filter on the files listed in the network section of the Codecov report. Useful for upload-specific path fixing

network_prefix.description: Specify a prefix on files listed in the network section of the Codecov report. Useful to help resolve path fixing

os.description: Override the assumed OS. Options are aarch64 | alpine | linux | macos | windows.

root_dir.description: Used when not in git/hg project to identify project root directory

swift_project.description: Specify the swift project to speed up coverage conversion

upstream_proxy.description: The upstream http proxy server to connect through

verbose.description: Specify whether the Codecov output should be verbose

version.description: Specify which version of the Codecov Uploader should be used. Defaults to `latest`

working-directory.description: Directory in which to execute codecov.sh

xcode_archive_path.description: Specify the xcode archive path. Likely specified as the -resultBundlePath and should end in .xcresult

xtra_args.description: Add additional uploader args that may be missing in the Action
